question: Find the total surface area (in m²) of a right circular cone whose radius of base is 70 cm and perpendicular height is 240 cm. [Use π =frac{{22}}{7}]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert units to meters: **radius** (r) = 0.7 m and **height** (h) = 2.4 m.

Using Pythagorean triplet (7, 24, 25), the **slant height** (l) = 2.5 m.

Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(r + l) = (22/7) × 0.7 × (0.7 + 2.5).

TSA = 2.2 × 3.2 = 7.04 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 7.04 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius** (r) = 70 cm = 0.7 m

**Height** (h) = 240 cm = 2.4 m

**Formula Used:**

Slant height (l) = √(h² + r²)

Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(l + r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02686c0ce3510664dc9fe91d58d7759b1274874fd0cb58c6acbae9531fa78a70.png] 

⇒ l = √(2.4² + 0.7²)

⇒ l = √(5.76 + 0.49) = √6.25

⇒ l = 2.5 m

⇒ TSA = (22/7) × 0.7 × (2.5 + 0.7)

⇒ TSA = 2.2 × 3.2

⇒ TSA = 7.04 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 7.04 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of a Cone

The distance from the apex to any point on the base circumference, calculated as l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the side surface of the cone, given by the formula CSA = πrl.

Volume of a Cone

The capacity of a right circular cone is calculated as V = (1/3)πr²h.

Unit Conversion Rule

To convert cm² to m², divide the value by 10,000 (since 1 m² = 100 cm × 100 cm).</p
